passages.text: Open your doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may consume your cedars!
passages.sermon: Lebanon, open your doors.\r\nFire will come in.\r\nFire will burn your cedar trees.
passages.original: פְּתַ֥ח לְבָנ֖וֹן דְּלָתֶ֑יךָ וְתֹאכַ֥ל אֵ֖שׁ בַּאֲרָזֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Wail, O cypress, for the cedar has fallen; the majestic trees are ruined! Wail, O oaks of Bashan, for the dense forest has been cut down!
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah speaks to the trees of Lebanon and Bashan.
He calls the cypress tree to wail.
The cedar tree has fallen.
The majestic trees are ruined.
He calls the oaks of Bashan to wail.
The dense forest has been cut down.
passages.original: הֵילֵ֤ל בְּרוֹשׁ֙ כִּֽי־ נָ֣פַל אֶ֔רֶז אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַדִּרִ֖ים שֻׁדָּ֑דוּ הֵילִ֙ילוּ֙ אַלּוֹנֵ֣י בָשָׁ֔ן כִּ֥י יָרַ֖ד יַ֥עַר הַבָּצוּר׃

passages.text: Listen to the wailing of the shepherds, for their glory is in ruins. Listen to the roaring of the young lions, for the thickets of the Jordan are destroyed.
passages.sermon:
The shepherds cry out in sorrow.
Their glory is gone.
The young lions roar loudly.
The thickets by the Jordan River are destroyed.
passages.original: ק֚וֹל יִֽלְלַ֣ת הָרֹעִ֔ים כִּ֥י שֻׁדְּדָ֖ה אַדַּרְתָּ֑ם ק֚וֹל שַׁאֲגַ֣ת כְּפִירִ֔ים כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד גְּא֥וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD my God says: “Pasture the flock marked for slaughter, whose buyers slaughter them without remorse. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich!’ Even their own shepherds have no compassion on them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD speaks.
The LORD commands me.
He says, "Care for the flock marked for slaughter."
Buyers purchase this flock.
Buyers kill the flock.
Buyers feel no guilt.
Sellers sell the flock.
Sellers say, 'Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich.'
Shepherds watch over the flock.
Shepherds show no compassion to the flock.
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י רְעֵ֖ה אֶת־ צֹ֥אן הַהֲרֵגָֽה׃ אֲשֶׁ֨ר קֹנֵיהֶ֤ן יַֽהֲרְגֻן֙ וְלֹ֣א יֶאְשָׁ֔מוּ וּמֹכְרֵיהֶ֣ן יֹאמַ֔ר בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֖ה וַאעְשִׁ֑ר וְרֹ֣עֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א יַחְמ֖וֹל עֲלֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: For I will no longer have compassion on the people of the land, declares the LORD, but behold, I will cause each man to fall into the hands of his neighbor and his king, who will devastate the land, and I will not deliver it from their hands.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD speaks.
The LORD says this.
I will not have compassion on the people of the land.
I will not show mercy to them anymore.
I will hand each person over to his neighbor.
I will hand each person over to his king.
Their neighbors and their king will destroy the land.
I will not save the people from their power.
passages.original: כִּ֠י לֹ֣א אֶחְמ֥וֹל ע֛וֹד עַל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַמְצִ֣יא אֶת־ הָאָדָ֗ם אִ֤ישׁ בְּיַד־ רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ וּבְיַ֣ד מַלְכּ֔וֹ וְכִתְּתוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹ֥א אַצִּ֖יל מִיָּדָֽם׃

passages.text: So I pastured the flock marked for slaughter, especially the afflicted of the flock. Then I took for myself two staffs, calling one Favor and the other Union, and I pastured the flock.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He told me to care for a flock.
This flock was marked for slaughter.
Many in the flock were afflicted and poor.
I obeyed and cared for these sheep.
I took two staffs for myself.
I named the first staff Favor.
I named the second staff Union.
I used these two staffs as I cared for the flock.
passages.original: וָֽאֶרְעֶה֙ אֶת־ צֹ֣אן הַֽהֲרֵגָ֔ה לָכֵ֖ן עֲנִיֵּ֣י הַצֹּ֑אן וָאֶקַּֽח־ לִ֞י שְׁנֵ֣י מַקְל֗וֹת לְאַחַ֞ד קָרָ֤אתִי נֹ֙עַם֙ וּלְאַחַד֙ קָרָ֣אתִי חֹֽבְלִ֔ים וָאֶרְעֶ֖ה אֶת־ הַצֹּֽאן׃

passages.text: And in one month I dismissed three shepherds. My soul grew impatient with the flock, and their souls also detested me.
passages.sermon:
God spoke through the prophet Zechariah.
God acted as a shepherd to the people of Israel.
In one month, I removed three shepherds.
I became impatient with the flock.
The flock also grew tired of me.
passages.original: וָאַכְחִ֛ד אֶת־ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָרֹעִ֖ים בְּיֶ֣רַח אֶחָ֑ד וַתִּקְצַ֤ר נַפְשִׁי֙ בָּהֶ֔ם וְגַם־ נַפְשָׁ֖ם בָּחֲלָ֥ה בִֽי׃

passages.text: Then I said, “I will no longer shepherd you. Let the dying die, and the perishing perish; and let those who remain devour one another’s flesh.”
passages.sermon:
The shepherd spoke to the flock.
He said, "I will not shepherd you anymore."
Let those who are dying die.
Let those who are perishing perish.
Let those who remain eat the flesh of one another.
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר לֹ֥א אֶרְעֶ֖ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם הַמֵּתָ֣ה תָמ֗וּת וְהַנִּכְחֶ֙דֶת֙ תִּכָּחֵ֔ד וְהַ֨נִּשְׁאָר֔וֹת תֹּאכַ֕לְנָה אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת־ בְּשַׂ֥ר רְעוּתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Next I took my staff called Favor and cut it in two, revoking the covenant I had made with all the nations.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a shepherd who represents God.
God had a staff called Favor.
I took my staff called Favor.
I cut the staff in two.
I did this to revoke my covenant.
I had made this covenant with all the nations.
passages.original: וָאֶקַּ֤ח אֶת־ מַקְלִי֙ אֶת־ נֹ֔עַם וָאֶגְדַּ֖ע אֹת֑וֹ לְהָפֵיר֙ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעַמִּֽים׃

passages.text: It was revoked on that day, and so the afflicted of the flock who were watching me knew that it was the word of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God spoke through the prophet Zechariah.
God made a covenant with all the nations.
God revoked this covenant on that day.
The afflicted people in the flock watched Zechariah.
These afflicted people understood what happened.
They knew this was the word of the LORD.
passages.original: וַתֻּפַ֖ר בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיֵּדְע֨וּ כֵ֜ן עֲנִיֵּ֤י הַצֹּאן֙ הַשֹּׁמְרִ֣ים אֹתִ֔י כִּ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Then I told them, “If it seems right to you, give me my wages; but if not, keep them.” So they weighed out my wages, thirty pieces of silver.
passages.sermon:
I spoke to the people.
I said, "If you think it is good, give me my wages."
I said, "If not, do not pay me."
They paid me my wages.
They gave me thirty pieces of silver.
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם אִם־ ט֧וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֛ם הָב֥וּ שְׂכָרִ֖י וְאִם־ לֹ֣א׀ חֲדָ֑לוּ וַיִּשְׁקְל֥וּ אֶת־ שְׂכָרִ֖י שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים כָּֽסֶף׃

passages.text: And the LORD said to me, “Throw it to the potter”—this magnificent price at which they valued me. So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
The LORD told me to throw the money to the potter.
The people valued me at a high price.
They paid me thirty pieces of silver.
I took the thirty pieces of silver.
I threw the silver to the potter in the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הַשְׁלִיכֵ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ הַיּוֹצֵ֔ר אֶ֣דֶר הַיְקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָקַ֖רְתִּי מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וָֽאֶקְחָה֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים הַכֶּ֔סֶף וָאַשְׁלִ֥יךְ אֹת֛וֹ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ הַיּוֹצֵֽר׃

passages.text: Then I cut in two my second staff called Union, breaking the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah acted out a message from God.
He held two staffs.
He called the second staff Union.
I cut the second staff in two.
This act broke the bond of unity.
The brotherhood between Judah and Israel ended.
passages.original: וָֽאֶגְדַּע֙ אֶת־ מַקְלִ֣י הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֵ֖ת הַחֹֽבְלִ֑ים לְהָפֵר֙ אֶת־ הָֽאַחֲוָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבֵ֥ין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: And the LORD said to me: “Take up once more the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
The LORD gave me a command.
The LORD told me to take the tools of a shepherd.
The LORD said these tools belong to a foolish shepherd.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י ע֣וֹד קַח־ לְךָ֔ כְּלִ֖י רֹעֶ֥ה אֱוִלִֽי׃

passages.text: For behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will neither care for the lost, nor seek the young, nor heal the broken, nor sustain the healthy, but he will devour the flesh of the choice sheep and tear off their hooves.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about the land of Israel.
God says, “I will raise up a shepherd in this land.
This shepherd will be foolish and evil.
He will not care for the lost sheep.
He will not look for the young sheep.
He will not heal the sheep that are broken.
He will not provide for the sheep that are standing and healthy.
He will eat the flesh of the best and strongest sheep.
He will tear off their hooves.
This shepherd will harm the flock instead of helping it.”
passages.original: כִּ֣י הִנֵּֽה־ אָנֹכִי֩ מֵקִ֨ים רֹעֶ֜ה בָּאָ֗רֶץ הַנִּכְחָד֤וֹת לֹֽא־ יִפְקֹד֙ הַנַּ֣עַר לֹֽא־ יְבַקֵּ֔שׁ וְהַנִּשְׁבֶּ֖רֶת לֹ֣א יְרַפֵּ֑א הַנִּצָּבָה֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכֵּ֔ל וּבְשַׂ֤ר הַבְּרִיאָה֙ יֹאכַ֔ל וּפַרְסֵיהֶ֖ן יְפָרֵֽק׃ס

passages.text: Woe to the worthless shepherd, who deserts the flock! May a sword strike his arm and his right eye! May his arm be completely withered and his right eye utterly blinded!”
passages.sermon:
God speaks about a shepherd.
This shepherd is worthless.
He abandons his flock.
Disaster will come to this shepherd.
A sword will strike his arm.
A sword will strike his right eye.
His arm will become completely withered.
His right eye will become totally blind.
passages.original: ה֣וֹי רֹעִ֤י הָֽאֱלִיל֙ עֹזְבִ֣י הַצֹּ֔אן חֶ֥רֶב עַל־ זְרוֹע֖וֹ וְעַל־ עֵ֣ין יְמִינ֑וֹ זְרֹעוֹ֙ יָב֣וֹשׁ תִּיבָ֔שׁ וְעֵ֥ין יְמִינ֖וֹ כָּהֹ֥ה תִכְהֶֽה׃ס
